featureName: Apply every typed merge-policy mutation to its committed specification vector

scenarios.name: Apply <id> to its committed before-snapshot fixture [id=change-merge-policy, policy=Vigilant, wasPolicy=Normal]

steps.text: the committed before-snapshot, mutation and outcome fixtures for the change-merge-policy kind
the resulting setting matches the committed after-snapshot, carries the Vigilant authority, no longer carries Normal, and reports the committed outcome

scenarios.name: Undoing <id> restores the committed before-snapshot fixture [id=change-merge-policy, policy=Vigilant, wasPolicy=Normal]

steps.text: the committed before-snapshot and mutation fixtures for the change-merge-policy kind
change-merge-policy is applied and then its own computed inverse steps are applied
the setting equals the committed before-snapshot again and carries Normal once more

scenarios.name: Re-applying the policy a record already carries is a warned no-op that keeps the record

steps.text: the committed before-snapshot of the change-merge-policy vector
change-merge-policy is applied carrying the policy that record already holds
a mutation.no-op warning is raised and the setting is returned unchanged rather than reset to the facet default

scenarios.name: Decode and re-encode the committed merge-policy setting without passing bytes through

steps.text: the committed before-snapshot of the change-merge-policy vector
the setting is decoded into MergePolicySetting and re-encoded from the typed value alone
the re-encoded projection is the committed one, and the decode is proven real by reading the active policy back off the typed value rather than off the text
